newsitem.title: USA: Automatic Data buys proxy unit of Mass. co.
newsitem.headline: Automatic Data buys proxy unit of Mass. co.

text.p: Automatic Data Processing Inc said Tuesday it has agreed to buy the global proxy processing business of privately held Global Proxy Services Corp of Concord, Massachusetts, for undisclosed terms.
The new business segment will be managed by Barton Hill, vice president of Global Proxy, both companies said.
The business will become part of Automatic Data's Investor Communications Services business, which provides proxy service to banks and broker dealers in the United States and Canada.
Automatic Data provides computerized transaction processing, data communications, software and information services to clients in various industries.
